name: @bryance/orch
description: Fleet orchestration control plane for coding agent harnesses and terminal multiplexers - orchestrate and control coding agents from any provider.

scripts.build:cli: bun run retire-daemon && bun run build:ext && bun run build:bin && bun run build:daemon && bun run build:hooks && bun run build:notify
scripts.build:ext: bun run build:ext:pi && bun run build:ext:omp
scripts.build:bin: bun build bin/orch.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile dist/bin/orch.js && bun build bin/orch-ding.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile dist/bin/orch-ding.js && bun scripts/build-bin.ts
scripts.install:global: bun run build:cli && tarball=$(npm pack --silent) && npm install -g "./$tarball" && rm -f "$tarball"
scripts.build:dev: bun scripts/reset.ts --build && bun run install:global && ORCH=$(npm prefix -g)/bin/orch && "$ORCH" doctor -y && "$ORCH" daemon start
scripts.lint: bunx oxlint bin src test extensions scripts
scripts.reinstall: bun scripts/reset.ts && bun run install:global && ORCH=$(npm prefix -g)/bin/orch && "$ORCH" setup && "$ORCH" doctor -y && "$ORCH" daemon start

author: Bryan Edman
